overview: The STATUS-state server info reply is invisible to server-side anticheats: it predates encryption and world state, and the corpus shows only registration and wrapper plumbing. Artemis maps the packet in its repository and wraps PacketStatusOutServerInfo for its packet library, Negativity lists SERVER_INFO in its packet type registry, and NoCheatPlus keeps deprecated protect-clients MOTD config constants that never became checks. Nothing client-controlled flows through the response, so there is no detection surface.

checks.name: Status packet registration and wrapper (Artemis)
checks.purpose: Registers PacketStatusServerInfo in Artemis's packet repository and wraps the raw status response so the library can read the packet stream.
checks.how_it_works: PacketRepository maps SERVER_STATUS + 1 to PacketStatusServerInfo.class and HardcodeMap binds the NMS name PacketStatusOutServerInfo to that interface. The wrapper class PacketStatusServerInfoServer extends GPacket and implements ReadableBuffer, giving the status packet a typed slot in the library.
checks.detects: No detection logic. The wrapper exists so STATUS-state traffic is fully typed; no Artemis check subscribes to it.
checks.variations: Negativity's PacketType lists SERVER_INFO ("OutServerInfo") alongside its proxy-side ServerInfo model, and NoCheatPlus carries deprecated PROTECT_CLIENTS_MOTD_ACTIVE and PROTECT_CLIENTS_MOTD_ALLOWALL constants in ConfPaths. Neither inspects the response.
